name: Zabdiel
overview: Zabdiel was a male Levite who served as an overseer of the priests. His role is specifically noted in Nehemiah 11:14, indicating a leadership position within the priestly community. There are no additional personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Zabdiel means 'G-d bestows,' reflecting a theologically rich Hebrew name. This proper name, as recorded in Nehemiah 11:14, does not indicate it was given directly by God but still carries a meaningful divine association.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture identifies Zabdiel as the son of Haggedolim, as explicitly stated in Nehemiah 11:14. Beyond this father-son relationship, no other family connections are recorded for him.
scriptureSignificance: Zabdiel's significance lies in his leadership role among the Levite priests during the post-exilic period, as overseer of the priests. His mention in Nehemiah 11:14 situates him within the restored community of Israel, entrusted with spiritual oversight. This highlights the continuity of priestly service and governance following Israel's return from exile.
